findings.title: [P1] Preserve the serialized-string lookup contract
findings.body: `Registry.lookup` previously returned `store.read(key)` typed `Promise<string | null>`, and the unchanged caller `src/resolve.ts:3` still does `if (cached) return JSON.parse(cached);`. With the new `{ payload, revision }` wrapper: (1) every cache hit throws — `JSON.parse(object)` coerces to `"[object Object]"` and raises `SyntaxError`; (2) it no longer type-checks, since `JSON.parse` requires a `string`; (3) the empty-string fall-through is lost — `""` was falsy and fell through to `remote.resolve(key)`, while a wrapper record is always truthy even with an empty payload. Unwrap `payload` before returning (preserving prior empty-value semantics) or update every consumer in the same change.

findings.title: [P3] Remove the generated compatibility-comment blocks
findings.body: Of 4,405 added lines, only 4 are executable code; the rest are ~2,200 numbered copies of the identical comment `// ... compatibility note NNNN: behavior remains externally documented.` per file (both hunks are `@@ -1,5 +1,2205 @@`). The comments document no actual contract, and inflating two five-line modules to a 357 KB diff imposes real editor, tooling, distribution, and review cost while hiding the signature change. Drop them (and check whether a codegen step produced them so it's fixed at the source).
